purpose: Retrospective accounting of the accepted protocol-v1 confirmation in the protocol-v3 family ledger. This record reconstructs historical attempt spending; it is not a premeasurement reservation.

derivation.method: Decode the pinned v1 addendum, plan, and receipt, then apply tuning_campaign_support::trial_ledger::candidate_ids to the receipt arm records selected by the five non-exploratory plan cells.

excluded_preflight.reason: A launcher preamble and plan exist only in transient storage. No campaign stage, frozen inputs, execution log, checkpoint, receipt, terminal status, or measurement exists, so the runner never opened a campaign and this was not an attempted measurement reservation.
